actual_request.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE original full-body transparent game walking sprite, character 10_crimson_spear_girl, frame W12 of16. Native at least1024x1024. Image1 is edit target and exact west/left-facing proportion reference. Image2 is original character identity ONLY. Image3 is confirmed MAIN STYLE: clean bright rounded hand-painted Daoist chibi, no interface copied.
Change ONLY the actual legs and tiny natural cloth response to this gait phase: RIGHT single support just BEFORE left passing: FAR anatomical RIGHT boot stays planted under body at screen-left. NEAR anatomical LEFT knee is gently bent, the near left boot low in the air just behind the far supporting ankle, a little further screen-right than in Image1. Lower the raised knee compared with Image1 so this is ordinary relaxed walking, not high-knee running. Near thigh crosses IN FRONT of far thigh.
Lock Image1 face, two buns and long tails, torso, two hands and original left-high/right-low spear grip, red/ivory/gold costume and boots, exact full weapon, head/body proportions, subject scale and framing. No whole-character translation, mirroring, image deformation, running, jumping, high knees, extra limbs or crossed ankles. Keep calm short stride and at least one support foot. Entire hair, spear tip/butt and feet inside margins. Actual transparent alpha, no background/floor/shadow/checkerboard/text. Highest visual finish.
